text.tspan: Scan facilities: close transfers, preserve required GC, then retire
Root / VM lifetime and old epoch / mutex lifetime are distinct
RFS01 / Serving
Validate identities and pin before use
Epochs / transfers admitted by one authority
RFS02 / ClosingTransfers
Reject new independent handoffs
Drain enrolled preparation / issued permits
CONTINUE GC required by existing managed users
RFS03 / valid successor for SAME heap
Root discovery / driver / worker route qualified
No stale direct mutex address in future users
RFS03 / no successor: actual VM use closure
Callbacks / parked roots / reentry / producers resolved
No remaining legitimate future GC issuer
RFS04 / seal old independent collector entry
All handoff reservations resolved
Already admitted epochs may still derive scan work
Do not close their queue publication early
RFS05 / physical drain
All old phases terminal; no queue / cursor users
No waiter / signaller / writer / resolver / late borrower
Count zero and empty queue are insufficient
RFS06 / Retired
Withdraw resolution; destroy old scan condvar / mutex
Outside metadata locks, only after actual user cut
Allocation locks and heap free need separate cuts
Failed / unknown drain
Keep actual facilities / root / VM custody live
Timeout is not successful retirement
Actual cleanup_mem_vmstate destroys scan facilities
BEFORE residual pstate cleanup / heap free
Split or guard destructive source path
No opaque wait under vm_list_mut
